messages:
claire_auditor: Hi team — quick follow-up for the SOC 2 review. We need certs/evidence for three items covering the audit window 2024-10-01 to 2025-03-31: 1) auth/login event retention and export procedure, 2) CloudTrail and KMS/HSM rotation logs (proof of rotation + attestation), and 3) step-by-step repro so auditors can pull the same exports. Also need an ETA to get HSM attestation PDF. Can you confirm where to fetch these and estimated delivery time?

maya_ops: Thanks Claire — looping in infra and security. We have an evidence bucket and a documented export process. cc @eric_infra @samira_security. I can assemble the exports but need to confirm exact date ranges and whether you want raw CloudTrail JSON or CSV summaries.

claire_auditor: Raw JSON for CloudTrail preferred, and a CSV summary is fine as a supplemental file. Please include checksums and a short readme with commands used to produce the export.

eric_infra: Quick notes / commands to reproduce CloudTrail + KMS event export: 
```
# CloudTrail lookup for Key events
aws cloudtrail lookup-events \
  --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=RotateKey \
  --start-time 2024-10-01T00:00:00Z \
  --end-time 2025-03-31T23:59:59Z \
  --query 'Events[*].CloudTrailEvent' > cloudtrail_kms_rotate.json

# KMS key rotation status
aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345

# Example internal exporter (preferred reproducible path)
./audit-exporter export \
  --range "2024-10-01:2025-03-31" \
  --types cloudtrail,auth,kms \
  --output s3://redwood-audit-review/CLAIRE-2025-03-01/ \
  --format json
```
(We will include the exact key ARNs in the readme.)

samira_security: Regarding retention and evidence: auth events are collected by our auth service and forwarded to the audit pipeline. Retention policy: hot logs (searchable) = 1 year, cold archival (S3 Glacier) = 7 years. CloudTrail is configured to log management and data events to an encrypted S3 bucket with object lock enabled for the 7-year retention. I will attach the policy doc (internal link) and the bucket policy snippet in the package.

maya_ops: Evidence locations we will use: 
- Read-only evidence bucket: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/buckets/redwood-evidence-prod (will provide pre-signed links)
- Confluence evidence page: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SEC/pages/9821-SOC2-Evidence-Pack
- Internal export job id (for traceability): INC-2025-042-export-71

claire_auditor: For KMS/HSM: need the rotation record plus vendor attestation for HSM (FIPS/PCI attestation or equivalent). If you have a signed PDF attestation from the HSM vendor for the key material used in production, include that. Also want proof that KMS keys used for customer data are under rotation policy and were not disabled during the window.

eric_infra: We have the HSM vendor attestation from 2024-07-12 (PDF). I will request the signed copy and include it. For rotation evidence, CloudTrail includes KeyRotationSchedule and RotateKey events. We'll include a CSV summary mapping key ARN -> rotation events -> timestamps. Sample lookup command for CloudTrail events is above.

samira_security: One more: auditors often want to re-run an export to validate checksum. We can provide a small reproducible subset (one week) and the commands. Example reproducible test: 
```
./audit-exporter export --range "2025-03-01:2025-03-07" --types auth,cloudtrail --output /tmp/audit-test/ && sha256sum /tmp/audit-test/* > /tmp/audit-test/checksums.txt
```
We will include the checksums and signer metadata.

audit-bot: Deploy finished: evidence-assembly v2.4 deployed to prod at 2025-03-02T18:10:22Z :white_check_mark:

maya_ops: ETA: I can package the full export + readme + checksums + HSM attestation and upload pre-signed links within 48 hours (by 2025-03-04 18:00 UTC). If auditors need immediate access to a subset, we can provide it within 4 hours.

claire_auditor: That timeline works. Please include a short timeline table in the package: when each artifact was generated, command used, who signed it, and expected retention. Also make sure the S3 objects have object lock enabled for the audit range.

eric_infra: Will do. Action items assigned: 
- @maya_ops: assemble exports and generate checksums (48h)
- @eric_infra: fetch & attach HSM attestation PDF and export key ARNs (24h)
- @samira_security: include retention policy docs, bucket policy snippet, and readme for auditors (48h)

maya_ops: Noted. I'll post the pre-signed links here once uploaded and include a short readme with exact commands used and sample outputs. :thumbsup:

claire_auditor: Thanks everyone — I'll look for the package and will follow up with any clarifying Qs after I validate the sample export.
